R-G4-V311.text: ADDENDUM-3 § C2 (the § B5 law bound to the v3.11 mechanics; ACCEPTED at the J0-F Gate-2, collab 608eaef56), rationale RESTATED by ADDENDUM-5 § E1: a step aimed at a GdRepositionFold WAYPOINT (waypoint() returned non-None for that body, that tick) is NOT a player-targeted pursuit step, whatever mech_is_player_target_step says (run.py hands the waypoint in the player_xy slot) -- prereg v1.15 (b') draws the same line (non-waypoint); most waypoints are INTERCEPTS placed where the body first comes within reach R, and the halt AT the player is observed one tick later as the GD Attack stand. The step's own d_engage_m (gd_engagement.halt_for: the chosen reach, or the current distance in Attack) is the law's operand, literally; a STATIONARY body is counted when the ring clip binds; an EMERGING body is not player-targeted (oracle verdict). CENSUS IDENTITY (ADDENDUM-5 § E1): an Attack-stand step always counts (dist - op = 0 exactly), every pursue-branch step is waypoint-aimed, and the no-state 2.4 m branch is the only other route, so on the V311-FULL baseline n_bodies_halted is a per-tick count of roster bodies in GD's Attack state (M-POL-2/0: 9,032 = 9,032); the field name is frozen and NOT renamed.

rowset_law: ROWSET = sha256 over UTF-8 bytes of the rows joined by exactly one '\n' (no trailing newline). Rows sorted ascending by the grain's KEY tuple, compared element-wise: integers numerically, strings by Unicode code point. Each row is the JSON array (separators ',' and ':', no spaces, ensure_ascii=false) of the row's fields in SCHEMA order (key fields first, then value fields), where every float64 is replaced by the string 'f64:' + its big-endian IEEE-754 bit pattern as 16 lowercase hex digits (ADDENDUM-1 § A5; Python struct.pack('>d', x).hex()); null, true, false, integers and strings are JSON literals; a list is a JSON array under the same rules.
file_digest_law: sha256 over the stored file's bytes (.jsonl, or .jsonl.gz when compressed), exactly as shasum -a 256 reports
size_rule: ADDENDUM-1 § A4 (closed before any diff): a grain file over 50 MB (50 x 10^6 bytes) is stored gzipped (level 9, mtime 0, no name); FILE digest over the .jsonl.gz bytes, ROWSET over the uncompressed canonical rows; uncompressed_sha256 also printed
